usual_baseline: Well under target. National BOAST 12 compliance 41.7%, neurovascular documentation 40.7% [1381]. Precise documentation 17% in one unit [1442]. Malreduction after fixation 25–33% [1364, 1350]. Only 27.7% of below-knee casts within 80–100 degrees [1451]. Weight-bearing X-ray in 20.8% of non-operative cases and CT for posterior malleolus in 48.38% of operative cases [1399].
fix_that_works: Regional teaching and infographic posters cut malreduction from 25% to 9.4% [1364]. A process change backed by education cut malreduction from 33% to 2.4% [1350]. Targeted teaching raised precise documentation from 17% to 88% [1442]. Posters and teaching raised saved syndesmosis stress images from 55% to 82% [1505]. A protocol cut inappropriate referrals by 53% [1227].
fix_that_fails: Education and reflection alone made malreduction worse, 33% to 43.8% [1350]. One teaching session and posters on cast position: 27.7% to 37.7% within range (p=0.231), with only a 3% gain where junior doctors were trained [1451]. The shorthand 'DNVI' persisted after teaching [1442]. Both national collaboratives reported no re-audit [1381, 1399].
consultant_advice: Documentation against BOAST is well covered, including two multi-site snapshots. Measure the treatment instead: malreduction on intra-operative films, cast position, or weight-bearing X-rays and early weight-bearing in non-operative patients. If you do documentation, close the loop, which the national audits did not.
